title: Bench - compute (agent/worker)
description: Cost of an agent/worker pair per partition and node packing. CPU in millicores (1 min rate).

panels.title: Busy pods
panels.description: Tasks a pod is processing right now (Core metrics exporter). Dispatched tasks are taken by an agent but not started: they wait behind the running one

panels.title: Ended tasks/s
panels.description: All partitions (Core records the end of a task without its partition)

panels.title: Tasks/s per pod
panels.description: Ended tasks of all partitions over the pods of this one: right when a single partition runs

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Calls of the end-of-task statement of Core (pg_stat_statements, postgres_exporter): all partitions, per pod right when a single partition runs

panels.title: Partition CPU (cores): used, requested, paid
panels.description: Used: what the pairs burn. Requested: what sizes the nodes. Allocatable: the vCPU of the workers nodes, what is paid

panels.title: agent usage / request
panels.description: Below 1: requests larger than the use. Throttled: periods capped by the limit

panels.title: worker usage / request
panels.description: Below 1: requests larger than the use. Throttled: periods capped by the limit

panels.title: Nodes by ComputeClass, machine type and Spot
Pairs of the partition per node
Workers nodes: CPU used / allocatable
panels.description: Near 100%: the node is saturated, the pairs wait for CPU without being throttled (requests below the use)

panels.title: Control plane CPU per pod (m) vs limit
panels.description: One pod near the limit while the others idle: clients unevenly spread over the replicas

panels.title: Control plane CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of the CFS periods where the pod hit its CPU limit

panels.title: SubmitTasks and DownloadResultData per control plane pod
panels.description: Balanced through the ingress (per request), unbalanced with clients on the Service (per connection)

panels.title: Ingress CPU per pod (m) vs limit
panels.description: nginx, every client request goes through it
